summary: C1 Explore review requests changes. Revision 050 correctly makes writeRunResult the sole publisher, but Q7 now says the adapter serializes RunResultFile to a JSON string and hands that string to writeRunResult. Q5 declares writeRunResult(runPath, resultFile: RunResultFile) and makes that function validate and serialize the object. The conflicting input types and serialization ownership leave the core write contract ambiguous.

blockingFindings.title: writeRunResult input and serialization ownership are contradictory
blockingFindings.evidence: Q5 declares writeRunResult(runPath, resultFile: RunResultFile) and its completion flow validates resultFile then serializes it. Q7 says to serialize RunResultFile into a JSON string and pass that string to writeRunResult. These cannot both be the contract, and moving serialization outside writeRunResult would bypass the stated in-function validation/publish sequence.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Choose one typed boundary and use it consistently. Recommended: writeRunResult accepts RunResultFile, performs validation and exactly one canonical serialization internally, then executes the exclusive publish protocol; Q7 should describe constructing the object and passing it unchanged. Add a contract fixture that validates the function input and confirms serialization occurs once before fs.link publication.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Resolved by revision 050: only writeRunResult publishes terminal result.json; the adapter no longer uses atomicWriteFile on that file.

checks.name: Formal API-contract review
checks.result: Compared Q5 writeRunResult signature and sequence with Q7 serialization/write behavior.
